name: session-learnings
description: Learn from finished Claude Code sessions: a SessionEnd hook queues the transcript, a launchd worker extracts lessons with a tool-less claude -p into a ledger that scores them draft → candidate, a recall skill shows only candidates, applications and skill usage feed the score, and /session-learnings:review promotes to a skill only after your approval. A weekly usage report of skills, commands, scripts and knowledge-path reads turns into proposals walked in the same review, and an opt-in weekly agent opens that review in agterm. macOS.
